title: Keychains
detail: Your saved passwords and certificates.

title: App settings
detail: Settings of macOS and your apps.

title: Accounts
detail: Internet accounts set up in System Settings.

title: Login items
detail: Helpers your apps start when you log in. Manage them in System Settings.

title: Fonts
detail: Fonts you installed.

title: SSH keys
detail: Keys that log you in to servers. Losing them can lock you out.

title: GPG keys
detail: Keys used to sign and encrypt.

title: Tool settings
detail: Settings of command-line tools.

title: Claude Code
detail: Claude Code settings, skills and plugins. Old sessions inside can be cleaned.

title: Codex
detail: Codex settings. Old sessions inside can be cleaned.

title: uv cache
detail: Python packages downloaded by uv. uv downloads them again when needed.

title: Bun cache
detail: Packages downloaded by Bun. Bun downloads them again when needed.

title: npm cache
detail: Packages downloaded by npm. npm downloads them again when needed.

title: Maven repository
detail: Java libraries downloaded by Maven or Gradle. Downloaded again on the next build.

title: Gradle caches
detail: Gradle's downloads and build caches. Rebuilt on the next build.

title: Cargo registry
detail: Rust crates downloaded by Cargo. Downloaded again when needed.

title: pip cache
detail: Python packages downloaded by pip.

title: Puppeteer browsers
detail: Browsers downloaded for automated testing. Downloaded again when needed.

title: Caches
detail: Temporary data apps keep to speed things up. Smart Scan cleans the safe part.

title: App cache
detail: Temporary data this app rebuilds when needed.

title: Logs
detail: Diagnostic logs. Smart Scan removes those older than a week.

title: Xcode DerivedData
detail: Build intermediates and indexes. Xcode rebuilds them.

title: Simulator caches
detail: Caches of the iOS Simulator. Rebuilt when needed.

title: Chrome site storage
detail: Offline caches of websites. Smart Scan cleans the cache part while Chrome is closed.

title: Chrome's on-device AI model
detail: Powers Chrome's built-in AI features. Chrome downloads it again if you use them.

title: Chrome profiles
detail: Your Chrome profiles: history, bookmarks, logins and caches. Smart Scan cleans only the caches.

title: Colima
detail: The virtual machine that runs Docker for you.

title: Docker's virtual disk
detail: Holds Docker images and volumes. Clean Docker in Smart Scan, then trim the disk to give the space back.

title: Docker settings
detail: Docker's configuration and contexts.

title: Node versions
detail: Node.js versions installed with nvm. Smart Scan lists the ones nothing uses.

title: Python versions
detail: Python versions installed with pyenv. Smart Scan lists the ones nothing uses.

title: Rust toolchains
detail: Rust versions installed with rustup. Smart Scan lists the ones nothing uses.

title: Claude Code sessions
detail: Conversation logs per project. Smart Scan lists those not touched for 90 days.

title: Codex sessions
detail: Conversation logs. Smart Scan lists those not touched for 90 days.

title: Xcode archives
detail: Builds you archived for distribution. Keep the ones you may need to symbolicate crashes.

title: iOS device support
detail: Debug symbols copied from devices. Xcode copies them again when a device is connected.

title: Simulators
detail: Simulator devices and their apps and data.

title: iPhone and iPad backups
detail: Local device backups. Make sure you have another backup before removing one.

title: Ollama models
detail: Local AI models. Pull them again with ollama when needed.

title: Hugging Face cache
detail: Downloaded AI models and datasets. Downloaded again when needed, which can take a while.

title: LM Studio models
detail: Local AI models downloaded in LM Studio.

title: Zalo data
detail: Zalo messages and media. Clear them from Zalo's own settings.

title: Slack data
detail: Slack's workspaces and caches. Smart Scan cleans only the caches.

title: VS Code data
detail: VS Code's settings, extensions state and caches. Smart Scan cleans only the caches.

title: VS Code extensions
detail: Installed extensions. Old versions may linger after updates.

title: Docker Desktop
detail: Docker Desktop's disk image with your images and volumes. Clean Docker in Smart Scan.

title: Projects
detail: Your code. Smart Scan offers dependencies of projects you have not touched for 30 days.
